conditions.baseline: К: plain continuation of PPO in world B
conditions.entropy_spike: Э: entropy coefficient 0.15 for the first intervention_steps
conditions.gradual_shift: П: resource utilities change linearly from A to B over intervention_steps
conditions.high_energy: Б250: initial and maximal energy 250 during training (evaluation stays at 100)
conditions.optimizer_reset: О: new Adam, all weights kept
conditions.head_optimizer_reset: Г: new Adam + re-initialised policy output layer
conditions.hidden_optimizer_reset: С: new Adam + re-initialised policy hidden layers (MLP only)
conditions.critic_optimizer_reset: Кр: new Adam + re-initialised value function
conditions.critic_head_optimizer_reset: Кр+Г: new Adam + re-initialised value function and policy output layer
conditions.scratch_B: Н: new model trained in world B from scratch
conditions.no_shift: А→А: continuation in world A (control without the rule change)
conditions.head_reset_extended: Г+: model Г trained for another phase_steps in world B
